articles.summary: Sylvamo (NYSE: SLVM) is entering into a put option agreement with Midas Atlantic Partners, in partnership with The Najafi Companies, for a binding offer to acquire the company’s Europe business, including its uncoated freesheet paper mills in Saillat, France, and Nymolla, Sweden, as well as its forestry and supporting business operations. Sylvamo will conduct applicable consultation processes with works councils and employee representatives in accordance with local laws before making any final decision. Once consultation processes are complete, the parties expect to enter into a definitive share purchase agreement to transfer the business to Midas Atlantic Partners with an agreed level of working capital and cash in exchange for the right to receive 20% of future distributions. articles.summary: Sylvamo (NYSE: SLVM), the world’s paper company, is releasing third quarter earnings. The company will host an audio webcast at 10 a.m. EST at investors.sylvamo.com . Management Summary from Chief Executive Officer John Sims As we announced earlier this morning, we entered into a put option agreement with Midas Atlantic Partners, in partnership with The Najafi Companies, for a binding offer to acquire our Europe business, including our uncoated freesheet paper mills in Saillat, France, and Nymolla, Sweden, as well as our forestry and supporting business operations. We believe this potential transaction represents an important strategic step for our Europe business and Sylvamo. In Europe, it would create the opportunity to move forward with an owner experienced in corporate carve-outs and positioning businesses for long-term success.
